rationale: The two solutions are essentially the same. They use the same sentinel errors, the same digit-parsing switch, the same overflow check before accumulating each digit and the same HandleErrors mapping using errors.Is. The only differences are cosmetic: A declares maxInt64 as a documented package-level constant and its range message mentions int64, while B makes the constant local to the function. B's doc comment is a little more precise about when each error occurs. Neither difference meaningfully affects clarity, idiom or robustness.
